title: Rams All-Pro WR Puka Nacua suspended 3 games for violating NFL's personal conduct policy, aligning with his IR stint

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams All-Pro WR Puka Nacua suspended 3 games for violating NFL's personal conduct policy, aligning with his IR stint
sources.description: The league has reportedly informed Nacua that any further violations of the personal conduct policy will subject him to further discipline, including potential banishment from the league.
